entities.name: QoS flow description
entities.description: Contains parameters defining a QoS flow, including QFI, bit rates for GBR flows, 5QI, and optional EBI mapping.

entities.name: QoS flow identifier
entities.description: Unique identifier for a QoS flow within a PDU session.

entities.name: GBR QoS flow
entities.description: A QoS flow type with guaranteed bit rate requirements.

entities.name: Guaranteed flow bit rate for UL
entities.description: Minimum guaranteed bit rate for uplink direction in a GBR QoS flow.

entities.name: Guaranteed flow bit rate for DL
entities.description: Minimum guaranteed bit rate for downlink direction in a GBR QoS flow.

entities.name: Maximum flow bit rate for UL
entities.description: Maximum allowed bit rate for uplink direction in a GBR QoS flow.

entities.name: Maximum flow bit rate for DL
entities.description: Maximum allowed bit rate for downlink direction in a GBR QoS flow.

entities.name: Averaging window
entities.description: Time window over which bit rates are averaged for GBR QoS flows.

entities.name: 5G QoS Identifier
entities.description: Identifier defining QoS characteristics for a flow, used when different from QFI.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Optional identifier for mapping QoS flow to EPS bearer in interworking scenarios.

relations.description: QoS flow description includes the QoS flow identifier.
Presence of GBR-specific parameters is conditional on the flow being a GBR QoS flow.
GBR QoS flows require guaranteed flow bit rate for uplink.
GBR QoS flows require guaranteed flow bit rate for downlink.
GBR QoS flows require maximum flow bit rate for uplink.
GBR QoS flows require maximum flow bit rate for downlink.
GBR QoS flows may include an optional averaging window parameter.
QoS flow description includes 5QI when different from QFI.
QoS flow description optionally includes EPS bearer identity for mapping.
